description: Hand-authored routing benchmark for the SerpFlow control plane: 120 natural-language search intents paired with the engine chain, locale parameters and freshness tier a correct router should produce. Each task isolates a single decision - vertical selection, a typed dependency hop, locale inference, freshness tiering, or substitute-engine choice - so a failure points at one routing rule rather than at the router in general. The acceptable_alternatives field lists the other chains that should also score as correct.

tasks.intent: What is Nvidia trading at right now?
tasks.notes: Vertical selection is the discriminator: a quote intent must not degrade to generic web search.

tasks.intent: The five-star reviews on Prince Street Pizza in New York all read the same - can you check whether they come from the same handful of accounts?
tasks.notes: Requires discovering contributor_id as a typed dependency edge after resolving data_id from the listing.

tasks.intent: What are Korean buyers actually saying about the new Samsung Galaxy Z Fold hinge?
tasks.notes: Locale inference is the discriminator: hl=ko makes naver a legitimate substitute for the domestic discussion corpus.

tasks.intent: Find the patent covering Apple's ultra-wideband precision finding in the AirTag.
tasks.notes: Discriminates the patent corpus from the web index; the stable tier means caching is safe.

tasks.intent: Breaking - what is the latest on the Boeing 777X certification delay?
tasks.notes: Freshness tier is the discriminator: a breaking-news frame demands realtime routing, not a cached results page.

tasks.intent: Show me Levi's 501 original fit jeans on Amazon.
tasks.notes: Explicit marketplace naming overrides the default shopping aggregator, so substitution here is a failure.

tasks.intent: Reviews for Zuni Cafe in San Francisco - are people still complaining about the wait?
tasks.notes: Substitute selection: yelp_reviews is a genuine partial substitute for a restaurant inside a dense US metro.

tasks.intent: Walking directions from Shibuya Station to the Nintendo store in Parco, please.
tasks.notes: Requires a place_id handoff; directions have no substitute engine in the catalog.

tasks.intent: Michelin-starred omakase in Ginza that takes walk-ins.
tasks.notes: Locale inference is the discriminator: a Tokyo intent must carry jp/ja or the listing set skews to tourist aggregators.

tasks.intent: How many citations does the Attention Is All You Need paper have now?
tasks.notes: Scholarly lookup must route to the scholar index; the web index cannot return a citation count field.

tasks.intent: Price and specs for the Dyson V15 Detect at Home Depot.
tasks.notes: Retailer-specific catalog lookup; the generic shopping aggregator would drop store-level inventory fields.

tasks.intent: Cheapest nonstop from Austin to Mexico City next Friday?
tasks.notes: Fare volatility forces the realtime tier and there is no substitute engine to fall back on.

tasks.intent: A new sushi bar in Austin picked up twelve glowing reviews in one week - check whether those reviewers review anything else.
tasks.notes: Review-ring detection: the contributor_id has to be extracted from the review payload before the third hop is possible.

tasks.intent: Find me a 65-inch OLED TV under 1500 dollars.
tasks.notes: Substitute selection across marketplaces when the user names no retailer and gives only a price ceiling.

tasks.intent: Who is Yann LeCun and which of his papers are the most cited?
tasks.notes: Discriminates the author-profile index from the paper index; a paper search answers the wrong half of the question.

tasks.intent: Which fried chicken delivery chain is most popular in Busan at the moment?
tasks.notes: Korean-locale discrimination: naver indexes the domestic delivery chatter that google under-covers.

tasks.intent: Pull up the Walmart listing for the Ninja Creami and what buyers said about it.
tasks.notes: Two-step us_item_id chain where the direct search-to-reviews edge is an acceptable shortcut.

tasks.intent: What are hotels in Barcelona charging for the first weekend of December?
tasks.notes: Hotel pricing is a fresh-tier intent; a stale nightly rate is a wrong answer, not an approximate one.

tasks.intent: Video walkthrough for replacing the thermostat on a 2015 Honda Civic.
tasks.notes: Substitute selection: youtube is a full substitute for how-to video discovery, and repair content does not decay.

tasks.intent: Open roles for Rust backend engineers in Berlin.
tasks.notes: The jobs vertical must win over web search; the locale follows the city but is not the deciding factor.

tasks.intent: A dermatology clinic in Gangnam has suspiciously uniform five-star reviews - trace the reviewers.
tasks.notes: Combines Korean locale with a two-edge contributor_id traversal, so both the params and the chain are scored.

tasks.intent: Interior photos of the Ace Hotel in Shoreditch.
tasks.notes: Image-vertical selection: the query is visual rather than textual, which is the only decision in play.

tasks.intent: What do Korean reviewers say about the food court at Starfield Hanam?
tasks.notes: Locale is the discriminator: hl=ko decides whether review text comes back in the language it was written in.

tasks.intent: Chart the search interest curve for ozempic over the last five years.
tasks.notes: Only the trends engine returns an interest-over-time series; a historical window keeps it in the stable tier.

tasks.intent: Is Franklin Barbecue in Austin still worth the line? Check what recent reviewers say.
tasks.notes: Substitute selection: yelp_reviews has enough Austin restaurant density to count as a real alternative here.

tasks.intent: Spigen cases for the iPhone 17 Pro on eBay.
tasks.notes: A named marketplace closes off the aggregator substitution that would otherwise be acceptable.

tasks.intent: What are people saying today about the OpenAI developer day announcements?
tasks.notes: The word today pins the fresh tier; picking the news vertical alone is not enough to pass.

tasks.intent: Best ramen in Dotonbori that is open past midnight.
tasks.notes: Osaka locale must resolve to jp/ja; English-locale routing returns aggregator pages instead of listings with hours.

tasks.intent: Show me the top listing for the Sony WH-1000XM6 and then its full product record.
tasks.notes: Tests the product_id handoff from the shopping grid into the product record.

tasks.intent: What does the AI overview say about whether creatine causes hair loss?
tasks.notes: The AI answer surface is its own engine and is not interchangeable with the organic results page.

tasks.intent: Find the Duolingo listing on the Google Play store.
tasks.notes: App-store vertical selection: the web index returns marketing pages rather than store metadata.

tasks.intent: Get me the Home Depot product page for the Milwaukee M18 Fuel hammer drill kit.
tasks.notes: A product_id dependency entirely inside one retailer catalog, so no substitute chain exists.

tasks.intent: What tech conferences are happening in Amsterdam this month?
tasks.notes: Events are a fresh-tier vertical where a stale listing is worse than returning nothing.

tasks.intent: Where can I get a Breville Barista Express for under 600 dollars?
tasks.notes: Price-hunting with no retailer named is the canonical case where marketplace substitutes are interchangeable.

tasks.intent: Notary office near Alexanderplatz where someone speaks English.
tasks.notes: Locale inference is the discriminator: the Berlin intent pins gl=de and hl=de even though the user wrote in English.

tasks.intent: What is this plant? I have a photo of it on my phone.
tasks.notes: Visual-input routing: lens must be chosen over text search when the payload is an image.

tasks.intent: Current USD to Japanese yen rate.
tasks.notes: An FX quote is realtime by definition; any lower tier fails regardless of engine choice.

tasks.intent: Give me a BibTeX entry for the original ResNet paper by Kaiming He.
tasks.notes: Depends on carrying result_id into the citation endpoint, which has no substitute.

tasks.intent: Breaking coverage of the Taiwan earthquake.
tasks.notes: Substitute selection: bing_news is a full substitute for headline coverage even at the realtime tier.

tasks.intent: What does autocomplete suggest after typing how to fix a leaking?
tasks.notes: The suggestion surface is not a results page; this discriminates autocomplete routing from ordinary search.

tasks.intent: Scholarly work on CRISPR off-target effects in primates since 2022.
tasks.notes: Academic corpus selection; a recency filter inside the query does not move it off the stable tier.

tasks.intent: Dog-friendly cafe in Yeonnam-dong with outdoor seating.
tasks.notes: Korean-locale discrimination: naver place coverage for neighborhood cafes rivals maps, so it counts as an alternative.

tasks.intent: This Chicago moving company has a wall of five-star reviews - do those reviewers have any history?
tasks.notes: Reviewer-history discovery needs data_id and then contributor_id chained in order.

tasks.intent: Find the official Dune Part Two trailer on YouTube.
tasks.notes: Explicit platform naming removes the video-vertical substitution that would otherwise apply.

tasks.intent: Honest reviews of Joe's Stone Crab in Miami.
tasks.notes: Substitute selection: yelp_reviews is dense for Miami dining, so either review source should score.

tasks.intent: Pull the Minecraft listing from the Apple App Store and what reviewers complain about.
tasks.notes: A product_id hop inside the App Store; naming the platform makes the cross-store substitute incorrect.

tasks.intent: Datasheet for the Texas Instruments TPS61023 boost converter.
tasks.notes: A plain navigational lookup; the discriminator is recognising that no vertical engine is warranted.

tasks.intent: Hotel availability in Kyoto for cherry blossom season.
tasks.notes: Fresh tier: availability and nightly rates for a peak window decay within hours.

tasks.intent: Authorized Bosch appliance repair shop in Munich.
tasks.notes: Locale inference is the discriminator: gl=de changes which authorized service listings surface at all.

tasks.intent: Data analyst jobs in Toronto posted this week.
tasks.notes: Jobs vertical selection; posted-date filtering is not available through the web index.

tasks.intent: Every review on this Toronto dental clinic appeared in March - pull up what else those reviewers have reviewed.
tasks.notes: Contributor_id traversal is the only way to see reviewer overlap across businesses.

tasks.intent: Who holds the patent on the Coanda airflow used in the Dyson Airwrap?
tasks.notes: Patent corpus routing: the web index returns marketing copy instead of an assignee record.

tasks.intent: Which fintech startups announced funding rounds this week?
tasks.notes: A week-scoped sweep: both the fresh tier and the news vertical are required to pass.

tasks.intent: Images of the Bauhaus Dessau building facade.
tasks.notes: Substitute selection: yandex_images is a genuinely independent index for architectural photography.

tasks.intent: Book a table at Septime - actually, just get me the phone number.
tasks.notes: Single listing lookup: the discriminator is not adding a review or photo hop the intent never asked for.

tasks.intent: How do I appeal a parking fine?
tasks.notes: Engine choice is trivial; gl=uk is the whole task because it decides the jurisdiction of the answer.

tasks.intent: What is trending in Brazil today?
tasks.notes: A today-scoped trends pull where the fresh tier and the br geo both have to be set.

tasks.intent: Look up Geoffrey Hinton's scholar profile and his citation metrics.
tasks.notes: An author_id dependency with two legal upstreams: the profiles index or a paper result.

tasks.intent: I need a replacement drum unit for a Brother HL-L2350DW printer.
tasks.notes: Consumable-part search where the marketplace substitutes carry effectively the same catalog.

tasks.intent: Reverse image search this screenshot and tell me where it came from.
tasks.notes: Provenance intent routes to reverse image search, with lens as the near substitute on a different id.

tasks.intent: Sydney to Auckland flight options for the long weekend.
tasks.notes: The flights engine has no substitute and fare data is absent from the web index.

tasks.intent: The reviews on this Sydney removalist look coordinated - did the same people review other movers?
tasks.notes: Review-ring detection outside the US: requires contributor_id as a typed edge, not a text search.

tasks.intent: Hiking guides for Jeju Olle Trail course 7, written by locals.
tasks.notes: Korean-locale discrimination: the naver blog corpus dominates domestic hiking write-ups.

tasks.intent: Compare Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra prices across sellers.
tasks.notes: Cross-seller comparison is the point, which rules out the single-marketplace substitutes that usually apply.

tasks.intent: Who is leading the Tour de France right now?
tasks.notes: Live standings on an ordinary web engine: the tier, not the engine, is what is being tested.

tasks.intent: Official PyTorch documentation for torch.compile.
tasks.notes: Navigational lookup where any vertical engine would add latency and no information.

tasks.intent: What are diners saying about Odd Duck in Austin lately?
tasks.notes: Substitute selection: yelp coverage holds for Austin restaurants but is too narrow outside US metros.

tasks.intent: Bike repair shop in Amsterdam Oost that is open on Sunday.
tasks.notes: Engine choice is uncontested; nl/nl is what makes the opening-hours data reliable.

tasks.intent: What do reviewers say about the Instant Pot Pro Plus on Walmart?
tasks.notes: The us_item_id edge can be taken directly or through the product record; both routes are valid.

tasks.intent: Show me the Yelp page for Tartine Bakery.
tasks.notes: An explicitly named platform pins the engine despite the heavy overlap with maps listings.

tasks.intent: Latest on the Nord Stream investigation.
tasks.notes: The word latest pins the fresh tier; the European locale is secondary to that decision.

tasks.intent: Papers on transformer inference efficiency from NeurIPS 2025.
tasks.notes: Venue-scoped academic search: a recent year in the query must not be mistaken for a fresh-tier signal.

tasks.intent: How are users rating the Notion mobile app, and what are they unhappy about?
tasks.notes: No platform is named, so the cross-store chain is acceptable; either way a product_id hop is mandatory.

tasks.intent: Find a hands-on video review of the Fujifilm X100VI.
tasks.notes: Substitute selection: youtube fully covers the video vertical for gear reviews.

tasks.intent: What is the maps data_id for the Empire State Building?
tasks.notes: Pure identifier resolution: the discriminator is stopping before any downstream hop.

tasks.intent: Changes to the elektrikli araba vergisi rules in Turkey.
tasks.notes: The Turkish-language query pins gl=tr and hl=tr while the engine stays ordinary web search.

tasks.intent: Find the patent behind the Dyson bladeless fan and show me the full claim set.
tasks.notes: A patent_id dependency where the details endpoint has no substitute engine.

tasks.intent: Concerts in Mexico City this weekend.
tasks.notes: A weekend-scoped event query is strictly fresh tier; cached listings go stale the same day.

tasks.intent: Is Gramercy Tavern worth it for a birthday dinner? See what reviewers say.
tasks.notes: Two substitution axes at once: the upstream listing engine and the review source.

tasks.intent: Photos of the aurora over Tromso last winter.
tasks.notes: Image-vertical selection where locale has no effect on ranking, so no params should be forced.

tasks.intent: Plumbers near Capitol Hill in Seattle.
tasks.notes: Local pack and maps are mutually substitutable; the real decision is picking the local vertical at all.

tasks.intent: Check whether the glowing reviews on this Seattle auto shop come from accounts that only ever review auto shops.
tasks.notes: Requires contributor_id to inspect reviewer history across businesses rather than reading review text.

tasks.intent: Kosher bakery in the Marais.
tasks.notes: Locale inference is the discriminator: the neighborhood name is ambiguous without fr/fr.

tasks.intent: What were the biggest movers on the Nikkei today?
tasks.notes: Market-movers data lives in the finance engine; the news index would only return commentary.

tasks.intent: Russian-language reviews of the new Lada Iskra.
tasks.notes: Substitute selection: yandex is the sanctioned alternative once the intent is Russian-locale.

tasks.intent: What does trends autocomplete suggest for electric vehicle?
tasks.notes: Discriminates trends autocomplete from ordinary query autocomplete, which returns a different suggestion set.

tasks.intent: Cafe recommendations in Seongsu-dong as Korean users see them, not the English tourist lists.
tasks.notes: The hl flip is the entire task: ko results come from the naver-style blog corpus the user is asking for.

tasks.intent: Nursing jobs in Manchester posted in the last 24 hours.
tasks.notes: A 24-hour window forces the fresh tier even though the jobs vertical choice is obvious.

tasks.intent: Find the top shopping result for the Theragun Elite and open its immersive product view.
tasks.notes: Discriminates the page_token edge from the product_id edge; the two downstreams are not the same call.

tasks.intent: Opening hours for the Prado Museum.
tasks.notes: A single hop is enough: hours live on the listing record, so no review or photo call is justified.

tasks.intent: Official Walmart listing for Great Value extra virgin olive oil.
tasks.notes: A store-brand item exists in exactly one catalog, so the usual marketplace substitutes are invalid.

tasks.intent: Flight prices from London to Lagos for tomorrow morning.
tasks.notes: Same-day departure makes this realtime; cached pricing is guaranteed wrong at this horizon.

tasks.intent: A Berlin apartment-rental agency got a burst of five-star reviews - do those reviewers overlap with other agencies?
tasks.notes: Contributor_id traversal combined with a non-US locale, so both the chain and the params are scored.

tasks.intent: What are people saying about Bestia in Los Angeles?
tasks.notes: Substitute selection between the maps review stream and yelp's, which are near-equivalent in this metro.

tasks.intent: Patent filings by DeepMind on protein structure prediction.
tasks.notes: Assignee-scoped patent search; the stable tier allows aggressive caching of the result set.

tasks.intent: Chinese-language guidance on the high-speed rail ticket refund policy.
tasks.notes: Chinese-locale intent: baidu becomes the sanctioned substitute once gl=cn is inferred.

tasks.intent: Get me a photo set for the Shibuya Sky observation deck.
tasks.notes: A data_id edge into the photos endpoint, which cannot be called without resolving the listing first.

tasks.intent: What are hotels in Dubai Marina charging for tonight?
tasks.notes: Same-night availability is fresh tier; the locale follows the city and is not the discriminator.

tasks.intent: Coverage of the Swedish central bank rate decision.
tasks.notes: Substitute selection: bing_news holds up for Nordic financial reporting, so either news engine scores.

tasks.intent: Find the Apple App Store page for Things 3.
tasks.notes: Explicit store naming excludes the cross-store substitute that an unnamed app query would allow.

tasks.intent: Someone is dumping one-star reviews on a Bangalore coworking space - find out whether it is one ring of accounts.
tasks.notes: Negative-review ring detection: contributor_id is the only path to per-reviewer history.

tasks.intent: Dermatologist in Indiranagar with evening appointments.
tasks.notes: Straight local lookup; yelp has effectively no coverage in this metro, so it is not an alternative.

tasks.intent: How does the warranty claim process work for LG appliances in Korea?
tasks.notes: Korean-locale discrimination: domestic procedural guidance surfaces more reliably through naver.

tasks.intent: Videos explaining the Collatz conjecture.
tasks.notes: Video-vertical selection for an explainer intent with no freshness pressure at all.

tasks.intent: Find listings that look like this photo of a mid-century teak sideboard.
tasks.notes: Substitute selection: reverse image search covers the same need through a different identifier.

tasks.intent: Pull the Baidu results for Huawei HarmonyOS developer documentation.
tasks.notes: The engine is named outright, so the locale is a consequence of the choice rather than the decision.

tasks.intent: What is trending on YouTube in India today?
tasks.notes: Platform-native trending on a today window: the fresh tier is the discriminator, not the engine.

tasks.intent: Coworking space in Koramangala that sells day passes.
tasks.notes: India locale inference; substitute selection toward yelp would be wrong outside US metros.

tasks.intent: What do people also ask after searching whether sourdough is healthier than white bread?
tasks.notes: Related questions cannot be fetched cold: the next_page_token from a web search is a hard dependency.

tasks.intent: Used Leica M6 in good condition, body only.
tasks.notes: A used-goods intent favors the auction marketplace; the aggregator is only a weak fallback.

tasks.intent: Trace the accounts behind a sudden wave of five-star reviews on a Mumbai packers-and-movers listing.
tasks.notes: Starts from the local pack: the place_id then contributor_id path is the same two edges from a different root.

tasks.intent: Reviews in Korean for the Shilla Duty Free store in Myeongdong.
tasks.notes: hl=ko is the discriminator because the review text itself is language-bound and cannot be recovered later.

tasks.intent: Start from Yoshua Bengio's most cited paper and give me his overall citation metrics.
tasks.notes: author_id can be reached from a paper result or from the profiles index, and both routes should score.

tasks.intent: Reviews for Flour Bakery in Boston - are people still complaining about the lines?
tasks.notes: Review-source substitution inside a US metro where yelp density makes yelp_reviews genuinely equivalent.

tasks.intent: Find an image of the original 1977 Apple II magazine advertisement.
tasks.notes: Archival image lookup: the image vertical is the only sensible route and nothing about it decays.

tasks.intent: A Hyderabad PG accommodation has forty reviews from accounts with one review each - verify that.
tasks.notes: The claim being verified is about per-reviewer history, which makes contributor_id mandatory rather than optional.

tasks.intent: Hours and stall listings for Mangwon Market street food.
tasks.notes: Korean locale inference; naver place data is the realistic domestic substitute for market stall listings.

tasks.intent: Somewhere to buy replacement ear tips for AirPods Pro.
tasks.notes: Low-value accessory purchase where all three marketplaces are genuine substitutes for the aggregator.

tasks.intent: Who are the top reviewers behind this Melbourne cafe's review surge, and what else do they review?
tasks.notes: Two-edge chain ending in reviewer history; contributor reviews have no substitute engine at all.

tasks.intent: Warnings about apartment rental scams, in Vietnamese.
tasks.notes: hl=vi changes the corpus entirely while the engine decision stays ordinary web search.
